🚨 What's HMPV? 🚨 A respiratory virus causing coughs & colds. 🦠 Mostly affects kids & the elderly. 📉 Less severe than COVID-19. 🚫 No vaccine yet, so good hygiene is crucial! 🧼 Wash hands, cover coughs. Stay informed! #HMPV #Health
